tools.name: search_businesses
tools.description: Search the Agora registry of verified local businesses. Coverage currently centres on Malaysia (Klang Valley) and expands market by market — if a search returns nothing for a place, say Agora does not cover it yet rather than that no such business exists. tools.name: get_business
tools.description: Full public profile for one business: offerings and prices, opening hours, area served, languages, photos and verification status. Contact details are never included — use contact_business to reach them.

tools.name: get_attestation
tools.description: Check whether a business holds a current Veri5 attestation. Returns the reference, the exact claim that was hashed, and the chain coordinates — so the badge can be checked against Veri5 chain 63868 WITHOUT trusting Agora. tools.name: request_quote
tools.description: Ask a business for a price on a specific job, as a structured request. Prefer this over contact_business whenever the customer wants a price — the reply comes back with a parsed price, conditions and availability, so quotes from several businesses can be compared. Requires an authorized key. Neither

tools.name: contact_business
tools.description: Send an enquiry to a business through the Agora relay. The message reaches the business on the channel it already uses; its reply comes back on the same thread. Neither side sees the other’s contact details. Only verified businesses can be contacted. Returns a threadRef to poll with get_thread.

tools.name: wait_for_reply
tools.description: Hold on until the business answers an enquiry or quote request, up to about a minute. PREFER THIS over polling get_thread in a loop: it returns the moment a reply lands. If it returns answered=false, the business simply has not replied yet — say so and offer to check again rather than treating it as

tools.name: get_thread
tools.description: Read a relayed conversation, including any reply from the business. Poll this after contact_business — businesses answer on their own time, so a reply may not be there immediately.

tools.name: report_listing
tools.description: Flag a listing that is wrong, unreachable, or not a real business. This feeds re-verification and keeps the registry trustworthy.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_thread · Private data: get_business, request_quote, contact_business · Public sink: contact_business.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_thread · Private data: get_business, request_quote, contact_business · Public sink: contact_business

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
